title: OperationalDAG
description: The operational task graph. It carries IDENTITY + DEPENDENCY + CAUSALITY, so it MUST be acyclic — a cycle is unsatisfiable and is refused by validate_dag_loop.py (a loop where a DAG belongs is a bug). Every node is SEMANTICALLY GROUNDED: it references a vocab/DataClass/service node, so governance reasons about WHAT is ordered, not opaque tasks. Correction/feedback belongs in a GovernedLoop, never as a cycle here.

semanticRef.description: The semantic substrate this task node IS (GlossaryTerm / DataClass / service / relation) — the grounding.

placementRef.description: Field-calculus placement (PlacementFact / phase-field) — where this node runs; a gradient on the field, not ad-hoc.
